articles.title: Oil little changed as supply concern lingers amid Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
articles.description: Oil prices showed minimal movement as Brent crude futures dipped slightly. In light of intensifying Houthi attacks impacting oil supply, Saudi Aramco has temporarily evacuated its headquarters. Libya's production has faced cuts following the closure of a key oil pipeline. Amid these challenges, Russia expressed a willingness to continue talks with Ukraine, contributing to the recent volatility seen in global energy markets.

articles.title: 14 Indians on boat attacked near Bab el-Mandeb? Houthis blame Saudi Arabia, claim rescue operation
articles.description: The latest developments come after renewed clashes between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis ended a United Nations-brokered truce that had largely halted cross-border attacks since 2022, opening another front amid the wider US-Israeli war on Iran.

articles.title: Egypt calls for Yemen talks as parliament weighs military support to Saudi Arabia
articles.description: Oct 22 (Reuters) - Egypt advocates exploring "every opportunity" to resolve the Yemen conflict diplomatically, its foreign minister said, ahead of a parliamentary vote next week on authorising the armed forces to support Saudi Arabia against the Iran-aligned Houthis.Any direct involvement of the Egyptian military, one of the region's largest, would raise the stakes in the conflict between the kingdom and the Houthis, an increasingly destabilising front in the spreading US-Israeli war on Iran.
